Unnamed younger brother }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{water color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |debut=''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' |enva=[[Xanthe Huynh]] |jpva=[[Yuna Ogata]] }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{water color light}} |series=''{{OBP|Anime Pocket Monsters: Liko and Roy's Adventure|manga}}'' |debut=[[HZM01]] }} |} '''Ann''' (Japanese: '''アン''' ''Ann'') is a character in {{aniseries|HZ}}. She is a student at [[Indigo Academy]] and a friend and roommate of [[Liko]]. ==In animation== ===History=== [[File:Liko and Ann.png|250px|thumb|Ann and Liko]] Ann first appeared in ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]''. She met [[Liko]] when she arrived at the room they were sharing together. After getting the [[Pokédex]] installed on her [[Rotom Phone]], she was given {{p|Oshawott}} to be her [[first partner Pokémon]]. The next day, Ann had her first ever Pokémon battle, using Oshawott to battle against [[Liko's Sprigatito]], which was soon called off. One night, Ann spotted Liko looking at [[Diana|her grandmother]]'s pendant and asked about it. After Liko noticed how close she and Oshawott were compared to how close she was with her Sprigatito, Ann gave her advice. When the time came for a school break, Ann headed home, leaving Liko at the academy. Ann reappeared in ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'', when she spoke to Liko after she had joined the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. In ''[[HZ008|The Door That Never Opens]]'', Ann spoke to Liko when she attended a class online. During the conversation, the two talked about the live stream that [[Dot|Nidothing]] would do in a few hours. In ''[[HZ021|The Lonely Hatenna]]'', she contacted Liko and revealed that she had acquired her second Pokémon in the form of her {{p|Sandshrew}}. In ''[[HZ035|The Wild Pair, Friede and Cap!]]'', Ann spoke with Liko before class and noted that she had caught a {{TP|Liko|Hatenna}}. Ann appeared again when Liko gave her presentation for class. In ''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]'', Ann arrived at [[Naranja Academy]], having enrolled as a temporary student to train for [[Tera Training]]. After reuniting with Liko, she met [[Roy]] and [[Dot]] and had a battle with Liko, using her {{p|Dewott}} to battle against {{p|Floragato}}. After a tough battle, Liko emerged victorious. During her Tera Training journey, Ann received her challenge, and managed to pass her first exam. In ''[[HZ054|The Treasure of Eternity]]'', Ann met up again with Liko and her friends and, after being introduced to {{an|Terapagos}}, she spent the day with them. During the return to Naranja Academy, Ann revealed to Liko her real feelings as a Trainer and together they arrived at [[Mesagoza]]. In the [[HZ055|next episode]], Ann stayed with Liko and her friends while they received information that they would participate in a battle against members of [[Paldea]]'s [[Elite Four]]. During the battles, Ann watched the matches with Liko. In ''[[HZ056|Liko vs. Rika! Towards the Battle's End]]'', she watched her friend and [[Katy]]'s battle against [[Rika]] alongside {{an|Nemona}} and Roy. In ''[[HZ057|The Terapagos I Don't Know]]'', Ann was seen with the other students during [[Clavell]]'s speech that began the second part of the Training. Despite this, her Gym challenge was not revealed. [[File:Ann vs Niko HZ066.png|250px|thumb|left|Ann battling Niko in the [[Tera Training Student Battle Tournament]]]] In ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!]]'', Ann participated in the [[Tera Training Student Battle Tournament]] at the Naranja Academy, where she faced [[Niko]]. In the [[HZ067|next episode]], Ann took care of Terapagos while Liko battled Roy, and during the climax of the battle, Ann joined the others in cheering for her friends. After the conclusion of Tera Training and the tournament, Ann revealed to Liko that she was returning to [[Kanto]] to continue her studies at [[Indigo Academy]] and that she would like to face Liko again when she is stronger. Ann reappeared in a flashback in ''[[HZ085|The Pokémon Paradise of Laqua!]]''. One year later, in ''[[HZ089|Where the Adventure Leads]]'', some time after Liko returned to Indigo Academy, Ann was heard telling her roommate that she was going to be late for class. In ''[[HZ090|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part One)]]'', Ann was seen with Liko attending a class on {{DL|Type|type effectiveness}}. After the class, she went with her new and evolved {{p|Samurott}} for the second part of the class, leaving Liko in the classroom. In the past year, Ann has become one of the best students at Indigo Academy, standing out for the Selection Team, which competes for a spot in the [[Pokémon League]]. During a battle against a Trainer and her {{p|Wartortle}}, Liko discovered that Ann had received an offer to join [[Blueberry Academy]] from the institution's [[Cyrano|director]]. [[File:Ann Vs Roy HZ091.png|250px|thumb|Ann vs Roy]] At night, the two talked about everything Liko had been through in the last few months, which made Liko think about her feelings after the events in [[Laqua]]. The next day, Ann talked to Liko about the offer she received and how the possibility of being in the Pokémon League was getting closer and closer. Some time later, Ann tried to defend the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] from some students, seeing that this subject still made Liko sad. In ''[[HZ091|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part Two)]]'', Ann met up with Roy again when he went to the Indigo Academy to seek Liko's help. Then in the cafeteria, the three talked about what happened to the Rising Volt Tacklers and all the public manipulation that [[Exceed]] and [[Spinel]] did on top of the events in Laqua. When Liko decided to go after {{TP|Liko|Meowscarada}}, who had disappeared, Ann challenged Roy to a Pokémon battle, where, despite giving her best, Samurott was defeated by Roy's Lucario. This battle began to draw the attention of some students at Indigo Academy because of Roy's affiliation with the Rising Volt Tacklers. After the battle, it was Liko's turn to battle and Ann served as the referee. Afterwards, Ann was approached by some students due to Roy's presence and Liko intervened and exposed that she herself is a member of the Rising Volt Tacklers, thus revealing the whole truth to those present. After Liko decided to continue traveling with Roy, Ann and Roy had a conversation about how the last year was for Liko and the three said goodbye at the bus stop. Alongside her Pokémon, Ann once again saw Liko start over, this time trying to expose the whole truth. Ann was mentioned by Liko in ''[[HZ111|Better, Farther, Stronger!]]'', where she revealed that Ann accepted [[Cyrano]]'s invitation and became an exchange student at Blueberry Academy. In ''[[HZ115|Welcome to Blueberry Academy!]]'', Ann had a [[Double Battle]] with [[Lacey]], but the outcome of the battle was unknown. After reuniting with Liko, Roy, and Dot, Ann met [[Ult]] for the first time before watching Roy in a Double Battle against Nemona. In [[HZ127]], Ann had a battle against Liko, using her Samurott to battle against [[Liko's Armarouge]]. After a tough battle, both Pokémon were defeated, resulting in a double knockout. In [[HZ131]], Ann traveled to [[Levincia]] accompanied by {{an|Nemona}} and [[Penny]]. She revealed that in recent days she had been training with Nemona for the upcoming battle; later, Ann watched Roy's battle against [[Master Mayonnaise]] along with the others. In [[HZ133]], Ann went with Liko, [[Captain Pikachu]], and [[Diana]] on the latter's {{p|Arcanine}} to go further in Laqua while Dot, Nemona, and Penny stayed behind to battle the Explorers. In the [[HZ134|next episode]], Ann, Liko, Captain Pikachu, and Diana meet up with [[Amethio]], [[Onia]], and [[Zirc]], as they worked together to help the Laquium affected Pokémon when Spinel activated his upgraded Laquium-activating machines. After [[Captain Pikachu]] destroyed the machines and Pagogo purified the Laquium from the Pokémon with Zygarde, Onia, and Zirc taking them to safety, Ann, Liko, and Diana meet up with their friends. Ann and the group then encounter [[Spinel]], [[Rubina]], and [[Indi]]. In [[HZ135]], Ann and her friends start erasing the Laquium Core, but the Explorers got in the way, even defeating Penny's {{p|Sylveon}} in the process. However, Ann and the group became surprised when [[Coral]] turned against Spinel and used her {{p|Scream Tail}}, nicknamed Screamypuff, to take Sylveon's place. Ann and the group became even more surprised when [[Chalce]] and [[Sidian]] also turned against Spinel as they with Coral decided to team up with the heroes in order to stop him for good. During the process to remove Laquium, Spinel merged with its Core, casuing it to awaken, much to Ann and the group's shock. Ann and the group tried to fight it, but it was too strong. However, they refused to give up and found out that the middle of the Laquium Core was the weak point that they needed to hit. In the [[HZ136|next episode]], Ann help the group give Roy and Amethio time for their Mega-Evolved Legendary Pokémon to get charged up so they can destroy the Laquium Core's defenses. Ann then witnesses the Laquium Core being destroyed for good. After the threat with Laquium was over, Ann returned to Indigo Academy. ===Character=== [[File:Ann Nemona Penny.png|250px|thumb|left|Ann with Nemona and Penny]] Ann is an energetic girl who is very extroverted. She has a habit of being messy, but is shown to be considerate, keeping her mess to herself. She expresses concern and encourages her close friend [[Liko]] to try and understand her partner Pokémon. Over time, Ann grew quite close to {{an|Nemona}} and [[Penny]], with Nemona watching Ann's battles and later being trained by Nemona herself. This was shown again later when the three decided on their own to assist the Rising Volt Tacklers. In ''[[HZ021|The Lonely Hatenna]]'', Ann revealed that she wants to be a {{pkmn|Trainer}} that focuses on {{pkmn|battle}}s, while Liko was still figuring out her path at the time. In ''[[HZ054|The Treasure of Eternity]]'', Ann revealed that her main goal was the [[Pokémon League]]. A year later, Ann had gained significant reputation and respect within Indigo Academy. This prestige led to her receiving invitations to join other Academies, including an exchange student program in [[Blueberry Academy]] from director [[Cyrano]] himself, which she accepted before ''[[HZ111|Better, Farther, Stronger!]]''. {{-}} ===Pokémon=== [[File:Ann party.png|250px|thumb|Ann and her Pokémon]] Ann's Pokémon are very close and friendly to each other. Ann is also very attached to her Pokémon, to the point that she considers them the biggest reason she follows through on her dreams. Despite being a beginner {{pkmn|Trainer}} like [[Liko]], her Dewott managed to stand its ground despite her Pokémon's weakness against Floragato. Ann is also a versatile Trainer, using specific [[move]]s on her Pokémon to cover their weaknesses, as analyzed by [[Rika]]. {{-}} ====On hand==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ann |pkmn=Samurott |stage1=Oshawott |stage2=Dewott |type1=Water |tera=Ground |img=Ann Samurott.png |img2=Ann Samurott Terastal.png |cap2=Ann's Samurott Terastallized into a Ground-type |epnum=HZ001 |epname=The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One) |vajp=Ayane Sakura |vajpnote=as Dewott |vajp2=Tasuku Hatanaka |vajp2note=as Samurott |vaen=Lisa Ortiz |desc={{p|Samurott}} is Ann's [[first partner Pokémon]]. She received it as an {{p|Oshawott}} from her [[Liko's homeroom teacher|homeroom teacher]] in [[Indigo Academy]]. Ann used Oshawott in a battle against [[Liko]] and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}, which was soon called off. It reappeared in ''[[HZ046|Welcome to Naranja Academy!]]'', where it was revealed to have evolved into a {{p|Dewott}}. It had a [[rematch]] against Liko's Floragato, but lost. In ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!]]'', Dewott was used to face [[Niko]]'s {{p|Roserade}} in [[Naranja Academy]]'s [[Tera Training Student Battle Tournament]]. It reappeared in ''[[HZ090|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part One)]]'', where it was revealed to have evolved into a Samurott. In the [[HZ091|following episode]], it had a brief battle against [[Roy's Lucario]], which it lost. In ''[[HZ115|Welcome to Blueberry Academy!]]'', it was seen alongside {{p|Sandslash}} in a [[Double Battle]] against [[Lacey]]'s {{p|Plusle}} and {{p|Minun}}. In [[HZ127]], Samurott battled against [[Liko's Armarouge]], where it Terastallized into a Ground type. After a tough battle, both Pokémon were eventually knocked out, resulting in a draw. In [[HZ134]], Samurott was sent out to help the rest of the Tera Type Pokémon in purify Laquium for good. In the [[HZ135|next episode]], Samurott and the rest of the Tera Type Pokémon made an attempt to purify the Laquium Core, but the Explorers interfered, losing [[Penny]]'s {{p|Sylveon}} in the process, until [[Coral]] sent out her {{p|Scream Tail}}, nicknamed Screamypuff, to take the {{pkmn|category|Intertwining Pokémon}}'s place. However, Samurott and the rest of the Tera Type Pokémon couldn't erase the Laquium Core before Spinel merged with it, awakening it. Samurott subsequently teamed up with its friends to take down the Laquium Core. It then helped its allies to weaken the Laquium Core, before joining its allies to purify the core in the [[HZ136|next episode]]. Samurott's known moves are {{m|Water Gun}}, {{m|Water Pulse}}, {{m|Razor Shell}}, {{m|Aerial Ace}}, {{m|Detect}}, {{m|Hydro Pump}}, and {{m|Drill Run}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ann |pkmn=Sandslash |stage1=Sandshrew |type1=Ground |img=Ann Sandshrew.png |img2=Ann Sandslash.png |epnum=HZ021 |epname=The Lonely Hatenna |vajp=Arisa Shida |vajpnote=as Sandslash |vaen= |desc={{p|Sandslash}} is Ann's second known Pokémon. It was first seen as a {{p|Sandshrew}} when Ann made a video call to Liko. It reappeared in ''[[HZ090|Eyes to the Skies Once Again (Part One)]]'', where it was revealed to have evolved into a Sandslash. In ''[[HZ115|Welcome to Blueberry Academy!]]'', it was seen alongside {{p|Samurott}} in a [[Double Battle]] against [[Lacey]]'s {{p|Plusle}} and {{p|Minun}}. In [[HZ134]], Sandslash was used by Ann along with her friends' Pokémon to help Laqua's Pokémon affected by the effects of [[Laquium]]. Despite trying its best, Sandslash was defeated when Spinel increased the intensity of his attacks. Sandslash's known moves are {{m|Drill Run}}, {{m|Rapid Spin}}, and {{m|Sand Attack}}.}} ====Traveling with==== {| width="100%" | {{ActivePoké|||nick=Rotom Phone|Ann Rotom Phone.png|electric|ghost|link=Rotom Phone}} | |} ===Achievements=== ====Tera Training==== Ann participated in the [[Tera Training]], her evaluation and overall score are: =====Gym Leader challenge===== * Unknown [[Gym Leader]] - Battle Exam - Basic; Approved (prior to ''[[HZ054|The Treasure of Eternity]]'') * Unknown [[Gym Leader]] - Battle Exam - Implementation; Approved (prior to ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System!
